decisions.reason: The compact rotating-skip dumper still has its own page and fits the firm's core construction range, so keeping this option open costs little while its market value is still emerging.
The articulated dumper is still presented on its own page in a growing industry, and its demand is not yet resolved, so the low-cost option should stay open.

Its presence fell from its own page to a mere mention, a weak signal of fading priority, but niche rescue vehicles in mining sell on long cycles and are built to order, so keeping it costs little until uncertainty resolves.
The compact telescopic loader keeps its dedicated page in a core lifting segment, and nothing yet reveals low value, so the option stays open.
A large order in the rental market confirms demand for the material lift, so its value is largely realized and it justifies further commitment.
1,000 operating hours in seven months of ore handling show proven field performance, which supports continued investment rather than abandonment.
